text: Duplicate sensor events can skew the rolling vibration average by inflating the total vibration value, leading to an overestimation of the actual vibration level. This distortion can result in inaccurate monitoring and potentially missed maintenance opportunities. Consequently, this can affect the reliability and safety of mechanical systems.

An industrial pump can exhibit high vibration readings due to misalignment between its shaft and motor. It may also be caused by loose or worn bearings, which can occur without immediately manifesting as a failure. Additionally, vibration can increase if the pump is operating outside its optimal flow range, leading to increased mechanical stress and vibration.

A prediction score must identify the model used to ensure the score is interpretable and traceable to the correct algorithm. It must also specify the feature timestamp to account for the relevance of input data over time, as data can become outdated or change meaning.
